display_name: Theodulus, one of the Ten of Crete

names.note: Read out of the life doxologia.ro links from its calendar for 23 decembrie, which names the ten: «Teodul, Satornic, Evpor, Ghelasie și Evnichian erau din cetatea Gortiniei; Zotic din Hios, Pompie și Agatopul din Epinia, Vasilid din Chidonia și Evarest din Iracleea»
Read out of saint.gr's head line for this man on the page of «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στην Κρήτη», 23 Δεκεμβρίου, with the rank word and the clause about Crete left off.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (28 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 23 decembrie — «Sfinții 10 Mucenici din Creta» (the line names the company; the ten names are in the life it links)
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στην Κρήτη», whose life page gives this man a head line of his own, «Αγιος Θεόδουλος Που Μαρτυρησε Στην Κρητη»

attestations.note: The life page `/3313/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian, and it is the same company: the ten martyred in Crete under the prefect who shared the emperor Decius's name. **The ten are enumerated**, by the page's own text and again by its second apolytikion, so each man keeps his folder and the nine others are already his `related` rows from the Romanian pass; nothing is added there. The page states a century, «τον 3ο αιώνα μ.Χ.», so a `dates` object is drafted where the folder had none. **No `locations` is drafted** although the page names this man's home: a saint located and dated across a whole century is what `map-span.test.mjs` exists to catch, and the home town is recorded in the life instead. Two apolytikia are printed with their ἦχος and their automelon, both of them the company's own, and both are copied into each of the ten; the Κάθισμα is a kind the schema does not hold and is left out. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 05.01.2026 (23. децембар ст. ст.) — „Светих десет мученика на Криту.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, AND IT ENUMERATES ITS MEMBERS: „Светих десет мученика на Криту.“ over a body that names all ten, «Њихова су имена: Теодул, Сатурнин, Евпор, Геласије, Евникијан, Зотик, Помпије, Авгатопус, Василид и Еварест.» — so the one heading makes ten rows, on the ten folders the corpus already holds and not a folder more, which is BRIEF.md §4’s ruling on a company that names its members. Identified on the whole dossier and on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep the company: the persecution of Decius, the island of Crete, the same ten names, and the prayer at the place of execution, which this book prints in Serbian word for word as the Romanian life prints it in Romanian. THE YEAR IS NEW AND WAS NOT WRITTEN: «у време гоњења Декијева 250. године» is a flat year where this folder holds «3rd century», 201 to 300, read off saint.gr as `traditional` — and the two do not contradict, 250 lying inside that century and saint.gr naming the same reign. Narrowing a century to the newest book’s flat year is a reading of the sources together and not of the newest one, so `dates` is UNTOUCHED, the 250 is recorded here and in the life, and it is an author question. `types` untouched: «мученика» is the `martyr` the folder carries, and the heading gives no other rank. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS, and goes into the life: that all ten were distinguished and honourable citizens, «најбољи међу најбољим», the best among the best; and that when they were led out to the place of execution they were exceedingly joyful and argued over which of them should be beheaded first, each wishing to be the first to go to the beloved Christ. NO `locations`: this entry names no city of any one of the ten, where the other two books give each of them a home. The ten `related` rows this folder already carries stand untouched and nothing was added to them — the entry names no saint outside the company. NO SERBIAN FORM WAS WRITTEN ON THIS FOLDER. The list gives him the bare «Теодул» and the heading gives the company no by-name of any kind, so there is no fuller form to write; the bare form was MEASURED FIRST and lands on FOUR other folders — `theodulus-companion-of-agathopodes`, `theodulus-companion-of-pamphilus`, `theodulus-of-myropolis` and `theodulus-son-of-hesperus` — and a five-member fold was refused rather than made, which is the 12-21 reader’s «Јован» refusal at a smaller count. The Serbian is carried in the quoted heading and in the quoted list. The Prologue prints no hymn (8 October 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Οι άγιοι Δέκα μάρτυρες μαρτύρησαν τον 3ο αιώνα μ.Χ., όταν αυτοκράτορας ήταν ο Δέκιος.» The century is the page's own; the reign is not converted into years here, and no year of birth is given. The folder held no `dates` before this.

hymns.text: Τὴν πολυθαύμαστον Κρήτην τιμήσωμεν, τὴν ἐξανθήσασαν ἄνθη τὰ τίμια, τοὺς μαργαρίτας τοῦ Χριστοῦ, Μαρτύρων τοὺς ἀκρέμονας. Δέκα γὰρ ὑπάρχοντες, ἀριθμῷ οἱ μακάριοι, δύναμιν μυρίοπλον τῶν δαιμόνων κατήσχυναν· διὸ καὶ τοὺς στεφάνους ἐδέξαντο, Μάρτυρες Χριστοῦ οἱ καρτερόψυχοι.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στην Κρήτη». It is the company's own, speaking of the ten in the plural and naming their number, and it is therefore copied into each of the ten folders.

english.text: Let us honour Crete, the land of many wonders, which put forth precious blossoms, the pearls of Christ, the topmost shoots of the martyrs. For being ten in number, the blessed ones put to shame the ten-thousandfold power of the demons, and so they received their crowns, the stout-souled martyrs of Christ.

hymns.text: Κρήτης τα εύοσμα άνθη τιμήσωμεν, τα διαπνέοντα, οσμήν την ένθεον, Θεόδουλον και Ζωτικόν, Γελάσιον, Σατορνίνον, Εύπορον Ευάρεστον, Αγαθόποδα Πόμπιον, Ευνικιανόν ομού, Βασιλειάδην τε ένδοξον, βοώντες αυτούς αυτούς ομοφρόνως, χαίρε Δεκάς η των μαρτύρων.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ήχος γ’, Την ωραιότητα — the second hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Δέκα Μάρτυρες που μαρτύρησαν στην Κρήτη». It calls all ten by name and is copied into each of the ten folders. Copied as printed: the site repeats «αυτούς αυτούς», which is its own text and not a reading.

english.text: Let us honour the sweet-scented blossoms of Crete, which breathe out a fragrance that is of God — Theodoulos and Zotikos, Gelasios, Satorninos, Euporos, Euarestos, Agathopous, Pompios, Eunikianos together, and glorious Basileiades — crying out to them with one mind: rejoice, you ten of the martyrs.
